title: EXCLUSIVE Sri Lanka Retreat
highlights: Discover Sri Lanka's rich culture with ancient temples and vibrant traditions, exploring the island's sacred sites and its deep-rooted heritage.
Witness the care and rehabilitation of elephants at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can observe them in their natural habitat.
Admire the breathtaking beauty of Huluganga Falls, a stunning waterfall cascading through lush greenery, offering a serene escape into nature's beauty.
Explore the spiritual heart of Colombo at the Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple, celebrated for its intricate architecture and rich cultural heritage.
Marvel at the wonders of marine conservation at Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, where you can learn about the preservation of endangered sea turtles.
overview:
About the Tour:
Endowed with a diverse collection of landscapes, climates, natural features and infamous beaches Sri Lanka has been enticing visitors for many years. Offering a myriad range of fun, adventure, and romance, it is among the best destinations in the world for those looking for an exotic vacation. Right from beaches, hills, jungles, ancient monuments, culture, history to nightlife, wildlife, and excellent food a blend of all these is what makes the soul-satisfying everything make it a paradise that bedazzles everyone!
Begin your amazing tour by visiting the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and watching the naughty elephants, yet adorable creatures bathe in the river near the orphanage where they engage in mischief, pull each other by their tails, and try to escape the hands of their caretakers in amusing ways. Awaken the adventurous soul in you by indulging in a myriad of water sports for fun and thrill in Bentota from jet skiing, banana boat ride, parasailing, paramotoring, speed boat ride, yachting, canoeing, kayaking, to boating in the mangrove forests. Conclude this tour by visiting the Red Mosque, a stunning candy-like red and white striped mosque named ‘Jami Ul-Alfar’ is the most spectacular building in your entire trip in Colombo.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Visit Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Transfer to Kandy | Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show
days.desc: Welcome to Colombo! Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can witness the daily lives of rescued elephants. Then, continue your journey to Kandy and upon arrival, check in to your hotel. Later, board your transfer and enjoy a scenic drive around Kandy Lake, known for its serene views and historical significance. Also, witness the vibrant Kandyan dance performance, showcasing Sri Lankan traditional music and dance before getting driven to your hotel.

items.title: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage Visit on a Private basis
Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show on a Private basis

days.title: Transfer to Bentota | En Route visit to Perandeniya Botanical Gardens & Tea Factory | Boat Ride at Madu River | Visit to Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to Bentota. En route, make a stop at the Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens, home to over 4,000 plant species, & stroll along the iconic Royal Palm Avenue. Also, you can savor the flavors of Sri Lanka’s world-famous tea at the Kadugannawa Tea Factory. Upon arrival in Bentota, check in to your hotel & later, get driven to the Colombo Port Passenger Terminal for a boat ride along the Madu River. Then, witness the endangered sea turtles in the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery.

items.title: Visit to Peradeniya Botanical Garden, Kandy
Madu Ganga Boat Safari | Balapitiya River Safari

days.title: Leisure Day in Bentota
days.desc: Today, you can explore Bentota on your own. You can visit the stunning Bentota Beach, where you can indulge in amazing water sports like windsurfing. Also, you can take a short boat ride to Cinnamon Island, renowned for its centuries-old cinnamon cultivation & learn about the traditional methods of harvesting cinnamon. Later, you can visit the ancient Galapata Vihara, a Buddhist temple known for its stone inscriptions or marvel at iconic handcrafted masks at Ambalangoda, a vibrant coastal town.

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After check-out, get driven to Colombo, the capital of Sri Lanka. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel & later, set out to explore the city on a sightseeing tour. Visit the Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple & witness a blend of traditional & modern architecture. Next, soak in the lively atmosphere of Galle Face Green and stroll through the historic Colombo Fort. Also, soak in the amazing views of the city skyline from the iconic Lotus Tower, Sri Lanka’s tallest structure and explore other attractions.

items.title: Full Day Colombo Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Colombo Bandaranaike International Airport. This is where your amazing Sri Lanka trip comes to an end.
